title: Writing Short Messages
introduction: Write a short greeting, thank-you note or message using a model. Begin with a capital letter and use clear spacing.
definition: Write a short greeting, thank-you note or message using a model. Begin with a capital letter and use clear spacing.
rules: Write a short greeting, thank-you note or message using a model. Begin with a capital letter and use clear spacing.

examples.question: Complete a birthday greeting: Happy ___!
steps: Read the prompt and choose the word that fits.

examples.question: Complete a thank-you note: Thank ___, Mum.
steps: Read the prompt and choose the word that fits.

exercises.question: Complete a thank-you note: Thank ___, Mum.
Complete a note: Dear Ben, please bring your ___. (book or books; use one book)
Complete a farewell message: See you ___. (tomorrow or yesterday)
Complete a greeting: Good ___! (early in the day)
